maxmemory-policy.description: What Redis does when it reaches maxmemory and has to make room. Defaults to allkeys-lru.

notify-keyspace-events.description: Which keyspace and keyevent notifications Redis publishes, written as the event flag characters. The empty string, which is the default, turns notifications off.

slowlog-log-slower-than.description: The execution time, in microseconds, above which a command goes in the slow log. Zero logs every command, and -1 turns the slow log off. Defaults to 10000.

slowlog-max-len.description: How many entries the slow log keeps before it drops the oldest. Defaults to 128.
